member.name: T:Spillgate.Zstd.ZstdCodec
member.summary: A managed Zstandard decoder (RFC 8878, RFC 9659). It checks the frame header (window against the cap, dictionary id, reserved bits) before it allocates anything, decodes block by block with buffers that follow the bytes that arrived, verifies the content checksum, and treats anything after the last frame as corrupt. It contains no unsafe code and does not depend on the zstd of any runtime.
